## 2026-08-21

### Impact

This release includes breaking changes for some Uplink APIs. See the full list of changes below or use the updated Connect example app as a migration reference. 

It also introduces an optional dynamic framework variant, as well as arm64e binary slices. 

### Changes

- Minimum requirements have been bumped to iOS 15.0 and Xcode 26.1.
- Renamed the package import product from `UplinkIOS` to `Uplink`
- `Uplink` is now static by default. There is a `Uplink-Dynamic` variant if needed. Only link one or the other. 
- Removed the root `Uplink()` object. Only retain active `Worker` objects now. 
- Create workers directly: 
	`uplink.worker(controller: sourceVC)` -> `await Worker(controller: sourceVC)`
- Worker `watch`, `accept`, and `close` functions are now async. `accept` and `close` no longer throw. 
- Watched event types now use Swift-style enum cases and associated values: 
	- `WorkerEvent.Terminated` -> `WorkerEvent.terminated`
	- `PageEvent.Request` -> `PageEvent.request(url, method, headers)`
- Worker callbacks are no longer delivered on the MainActor. 

### Requirements

| Name  | Version |
| ----- | ------- |
| Xcode | >= 26.1 |
| iOS   | >= 15.0 |
